title: The University of New Mexico
description: The University of New Mexico's official brand guidelines define the primary colours Cherry (#BA0C2F), Turquoise (#007A86), Silver (#A7A8AA) and Lobo Gray (#63666A), and the secondary colours High Noon (#FFC600), Sandia Sunset (#ED8B00), Terra (#C05131), Mesa (#D6A461), Green Chile (#A8AA19) and Deep Dusk (#8A387C).
